notes.title: "Update note 21st Jan 2022"
notes.content: - Now players can remap the Q & E controls for the menu. The visuals will not change, but it works as intended. This was done because of people using not QWERTY keyboards.

tags.feature: - Now players can remap the Q & E controls for the menu.

notes.title: BUG FIXES – PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Update now live with a few bug fixes. Notes:

[list]
[*] Pause bug fix (The time scale was reduced after pausing the game while changing heads/weapons).
[*] Church button resets player position to prevent player flying in specific room.
[*] Enemies won't blink after colliding a wall.
[*] Castle exterior roof collider fix to prevent player flying using roll.
[*] There was an infinite use of the goat head after rolling.
[*] Now if you play in windowed mode, the game will stay at fixed resolution.
[/list]
Bugs can be reported here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304780/discussions/0/3142927376025945827/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/1304780/discussions/0/3142927376025945827/[/url]

Thanks for your continued support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/

notes.title: Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition demo – grab your gun and get to the graveyard!
notes.content:
We promised there would be a Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition demo launching as part of the Steam Game Festival and – sure enough – it is available to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/]download right now from the game's Steam page[/url][/b].

The demo lets you play until you defeat the first boss, which adds up to a LOT of game to sink your teeth into! It's a great introduction to the game's gothic, nihilistic world for first-time players, and also a perfect opportunity to start deciphering the riddle that is Nongunz itself. And for anyone who has dabbled in Nongunz before, the demo lets you sample the all-new Arena mode, and local co-op. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cid3Gui.gif[/img]


The demo has been released as part of the Steam Game Festival and will only be available for the duration of the event i.e. it will be removed on Monday 22nd June at 10AM PDT, so be sure to download and play the demo before then! 

If you enjoy the demo and want to stay updated about Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition, please go ahead and do any/all of the following: 
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/]Wishlist Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition[/url][/b] (be notified when the game launches or goes on sale)
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/][b]Follow Nongunz: Doppelganger Edition[/b][/url] (be notified whenever we post news to the Steam page)
[*] [b][url=https://www.digerati.games/newsletter]Join the Digerati mailing list[/url][/b] (stay updated on ALL Digerati games)
[/list]

Your support is really appreciated – thank you.

Until next time, keep it mysterious!

Matt | Digerati  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304780/Nongunz_Doppelganger_Edition/
